name: blmcp
description: Lightweight MCP (Model Context Protocol) server and add-on for Blender from Blender Lab (projects.blender.org/lab/blender_mcp). Provides all 26 official tools for scene inspection, documentation lookup, viewport navigation, rendering, and Python execution.
suggestedPrompts: 使用 get_objects_summary 与 get_blendfile_summary_datablocks 检查当前 Blender 场景结构
使用 search_api_docs 或 search_manual_docs 检索 Blender 5.2 Python API 与用户手册文档
使用 get_screenshot_of_area_as_image 查看当前 VIEW_3D 视口画面
